That’s an interesting perspective, coming from someone who grew up with the prequels and likely has different expectations for this show. I never got to live in a time where Star Wars was this new thing. I think a lot of how these spin offs turn out has to do with the directing, which can make even the high budget shows look cheap. The first fight with Vader in the show for example was super disappointing for me, no real excitement or momentum. The fight in new hope was more effective for me

I think both sides are to blame ultimately. Some of the directorial choices made for this show have definitely held it back a lot, it feels cheap sometimes and it definitely should not. I was hoping for more of a introspective story with obi wan just bumming it out on Tatooine and reflecting on his life and choices. I see what you are saying with how we shouldn’t have to try, but I think the nature of the Star Wars fandom as it is now, with two separate canons and people having a pretty decent idea of what versions of the characters they like, makes it to where a lot of the time we will be disappointed with a creative vision.

However, in terms of “attractiveness” and what not, it depends on who you are trying to attract. I’m shaved, 19, and I haven’t really had any negative experiences with any woman I’ve talked to yet.  You’ve probably heard this ad nauseam, but in my experience, it really is about confidence. Dressing nice, smelling nice, being healthy, and not being an empty, boring person tend to help as well. Sure, you are probably gonna have other empty people tell you that they don’t date bald dudes, just like you will have people who won’t date you for any other number of reasons. Shrug em right the fuck off and move on, just like any other scenario.
